description: Search UK parliamentary written questions and the government's answers by keyword, e.g. what a department has said about potholes, NHS waiting lists or visa numbers. Returns who asked, which department answered, dates, status and an excerpt of the answer. Source: UK Parliament Written Questions API (Commons and Lords). For the full answer text use written_question_detail; it does not cover oral questions or Hansard debates. (cost: 1 credit)

q.description: string, required, keyword or phrase to search in questions and answers

take.description: int, optional, number of results 1-100, default 10

name: written_question_search
